gen-gf-tektur-gf-matangi: Distinctive from the first glyph, Tektur is all open curves and wire-like strokes. Matangi's hefty lowercase and rounded, open letters are the real strength here, a sturdy body under all that expressive wire.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-maven-pro: Tektur draws pipe-cleaner strokes with openings at every curve and an oversized lowercase. And Maven Pro, with its open c and gentle monotone line, would carry paragraph after paragraph without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-michroma: Michroma gives every letter generous space on both sides, with a tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips. Tektur, though, does its best work with expressive, poured-looking strokes, while Michroma keeps things spaced out.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-miriam-libre: Pipe-cleaner strokes with open terminals on every curve make Tektur instantly recognizable. Miriam Libre steps in with wire-weight lines and a lowercase as sturdy as cast-iron capitals, which grounds all that expressiveness.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One hangs its very large lowercase eye on a single laser-cut stroke width. Yet Tektur's wiry, open-curved heading adds a spark that makes the sturdy body below feel quietly confident.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Wide gaps between sizable lowercase letters make the body text feel loose and friendly, while Tektur's wiry heading stands apart. Mochiy Pop P One would glide through long paragraphs with no brushy thick-thin swell to snag on.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-montserrat-underline: Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase are impossible to miss. Montserrat Underline sits beside it with round, uniform bowls and lowercase that towers over its capitals, so the heading's wiry flair has a sturdy partner.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-mozilla-headline: Big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal give Mozilla Headline a friendly, contemporary read, even beside Tektur's wiry heading. Tektur excels at one unvarying line, while Mozilla Headline handles the talking.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-mozilla-text: Distinctive Tektur traces a single thick thread through every curve, with generous openings and oversized lowercase. And Mozilla Text, tall-bodied with flaring terminals, feels sturdier and more composed beside it.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans reads with a large central band and wide-mouthed curves, steady as though drawn with a technical pen. Tektur does expressive flair best, while Nata Sans does quiet clarity best.
